A large grey weathered concrete urn planted with a clipped boxwood ball stands to the right of the door. Dark green boxwood shrubs line the right porch boundary. The palette is composed of grey siding, white trim, warm honey teak, dark-charcoal metal fixtures, and stone — all cohesive and classically restrained. The atmosphere is welcoming, residential, and transitional between traditional and contemporary.
